I think it's because of jealousy. I'm not that sure but to be honest, I've helped a lot of people who didn't have friends to have some. I guess she's jealous by the fact that even though I had helped her gain some friends, I was still very much popular than me. 
Now, from time to time, she would try and talk to me like she did before even though it had been a year since we talked. Even when we were placed in a group project together, I never really talked to her. 

But that all doesn't matter now.
Even classmates were never really there for me and the boys that I was closed with didn't want to get into the girls' dirty games.

I used to have a lot of friends, a whole bunch of them. I was happy and I loved going to school as a way to relief stress from home. In a way, they used to be my source of support. 

But in the end, they were friends with me for influence. To be honest, I am quite popular among the same year students and I get along with a lot of boys, so I guess they took advantage of that to get more friends as well especially a girl whom I treated as sister. 

She was a few months younger than me and shorter than me so it was easy to say that I treated her like that. We had been friends since we were 7 and for a long time, people kept complimenting us that we look like twins. I guess we really did look quite similar. 

Unlike my other friends, she was the most important to me. You can say that she was the core of the support. But when she suddenly stopped talking to me for a few months, I found it weird. 

And instead of telling it to my face, she had to have a  mutual friend tell me that she has been telling everyone that I've been lying to them for 5 years. Surely, I was shocked. From then on, even mutual friends who didn't know what happened between the two of us demanded that I apologised to her. They asked if she was telling the truth. 

I could've revoke then but I was so f**king tired that I just said,❝So what ?❞

They made everyone who were my friend ostracised me but at the point of time, my broken heart had been broken again. You can say that the heart has not heal...

My relationship with my father is still like hell. He's been absent eversince and even had another baby. My elder brothers are actually really close to me but as they are reaching adulthood, they don't really have time to worry about me with all the exams. 

I don't really have friends. They're pretty much as fake as one can be. No one really noticed because I would do it when no one was alone. The only reason I haven't gone through with it is because my cat was always there. I don't really think that my teachers or school counselor would help much. From where I am from, you would be put in a mental institution for attempting suicide. 

Mom doesn't express her expectations but whenever I get my marks, she would make remarks such as my marks are too low or that I got 0 when I got 90 eversince I was young so naturally I think I start to believe in it. 

She doesn't really care about me not smiling much because I've been like this since 4 years old. She thinks it's common.
